unityApiContractRepair.finding: Unity LockBufferForWrite is valid only for CPU-written buffers. It is not valid for buffers written by the GPU or used as random-write targets; Graphics.CopyBuffer requires CopySource on the source and CopyDestination on the destination.
finalRoute: GPU-write destination buffers: CopyDestination, no LockBufferForWrite.
CPU upload staging buffers: CopySource plus LockBufferForWrite.
Whole reset/static payloads: LockBufferForWrite staging followed by UnityEngine.Graphics.CopyBuffer.
GPU-evolved partial dirty pages: SetData range fallback only, because whole-buffer copy would overwrite shader-owned pages.

modifiedRuntimeCleanup.action: Added CopyDestination factories, LockBufferForWrite CopySource staging factories, whole-buffer staging copy helpers, and narrow SetData range helpers for GPU-write partial updates.

Sargassum GPU-written boid ping buffers remain GPU-write/CopyDestination buffers without LockBufferForWrite; spawn and single-boid CPU sync now use narrow SetData fallback ranges instead of mapped writes on RWStructuredBuffer targets.
Foveated visibility cache and scatter indirect args now use staging copy into GPU-written/CopyCount destinations.
Cull telemetry counters use staging copy. Native vegetation A/B dirty backlogs remain DataVault-owned and release all writer locks in finally paths.
Thermal vent and ash particle GPU payloads have explicit layouts; smoke GPU-write particle reset uses staging copy.
Indirect args destination is CopyDestination without LockBufferForWrite; CPU staging buffer is copied into it.
Scatter LOD indirect args use CopyDestination plus staging copy.
Drone procedural indirect args use CopyDestination plus staging copy before GPU CopyCount updates.
Damage append point buffer and damage indirect args destination use staging copy instead of direct SetData or invalid LockBufferForWrite target.
Fluid advection GPU-write buffers are CopyDestination without LockBufferForWrite; dirty page uploads use narrow SetData fallback and release dirty page locks in finally.
Carve debris GPU-write buffers are CopyDestination without LockBufferForWrite; injected ranges use narrow SetData range fallback.
Readback request buffers are GPU-write destinations copied from per-slot CPU-visible upload staging buffers.
